articleTitle: 1Password Enables AI Agents to Sign In Without Exposing Passwords

claims.claim: 1Password has introduced a tool that lets AI agents log into personal accounts without ever seeing the underlying passwords.
claims.bestSource: 1Password for Agents Launches as the Trust Layer for Personal AI Agents - Yahoo Finance
claims.evidence: Password manager 1Password on Thursday launched a new tool by which users can allow agents to log into their personal accounts on their behalf, without the agent ever having access to a user’s credentials. Agents from Meta Platforms Inc., Anthropic PBC, OpenAI Group PBC and Elon Musk’s SpaceXSI will be able to log in to people’s accounts through it without ever seeing the password.
claims.bestPassage: Password manager 1Password on Thursday launched a new tool by which users can allow agents to log into their personal accounts on their behalf, without the agent ever having access to a user’s credentials. claims.claim: When an agent encounters a login form, it presents a unique digital key to 1Password; the vault then verifies the key, signs in the agent, and keeps the credential hidden from the model’s context.
claims.bestSource: 1Password for Agents Launches as the Trust Layer for Personal AI Agents - Yahoo Finance
claims.evidence: A unique digital key identifies the agent to 1Password when it hits a login page, and the request that follows tells the person which account is wanted and for what. When an agent reaches a sign-in form, it uses a unique digital key to verify its identity to 1Password.
claims.bestPassage: A unique digital key identifies the agent to 1Password when it hits a login page, and the request that follows tells the person which account is wanted and for what. When an agent reaches a sign-in form, it uses a unique digital key to verify its identity to 1Password.

claims.claim: The system is designed for agents such as Anthropic’s Claude Duet, Meta’s Grok Bot, and OpenAI’s browser‑based assistants.
claims.bestSource: 1Password for Agents lets personal AI agents log in without ever seeing the password - SiliconANGLE
claims.evidence: Agents from Meta Platforms Inc., Anthropic PBC, OpenAI Group PBC and Elon Musk’s SpaceXSI will be able to log in to people’s accounts through it without ever seeing the password. The password, one-time code, and other secrets never enter Claude’s context, memory, or Anthropic’s systems. OpenAI has connected ChatGPT Work and its always-on Dots agents to 1Password, and Meta’s Muse requests logins from 1Password whenever the integration is switched on.

claims.claim: 1Password supplies a trust layer that lets users delegate tasks while keeping sensitive data inside the vault.
claims.bestSource: 1Password for Agents Launches as the Trust Layer for Personal AI Agents - Yahoo Finance
claims.evidence: “Handing over a password, secret, or credential is a common shortcut to an agent, but can leave people with sensitive information in places they can no longer control as a copy gets saved for the next time,” the company said in a blog post . “1Password for Agents gives people a trusted way to delegate tasks to personal AI agents while keeping control of the passwords, secrets, and credentials those tasks require.” That's why we're partnering with companies across the personal AI agent ecosystem, so people can use the agents they choose while keeping their passwords in one trusted 1Password vault."
